description: Full-text search across messages, tasks, and shared files in this workspace. Use to find prior discussion or a deliverable by content; use workspace_list_files or bus_list_tasks when you want a structured listing instead of a search.

agent.description: Optional: your agent name. On a bus that enforces agent tokens, pass it with token to include your own direct messages; without proof only broadcasts are visible.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Text to search for in message bodies, task titles and bodies, and file contents.

name: bus_search
